title: LTV / Cohorts
description: Revenue of each cohort of first purchases or registrations over its first 90 days, optionally broken down by campaign, source, offer, network or country. Cohort days are UTC.

windowHints.d0: Revenue on the day of the first purchase/registration

incomplete: This window has not fully passed yet — the revenue so far, not final
legend: * The window has not fully passed for the cohort's youngest member yet: the number is revenue so far, not final. LTV counts purchases up to day 90; Purchases and Purchase revenue count all of them.
emptyFtd: Cohorts appear once clicks reach a first purchase (CPA_ACCEPT postback).
emptyReg: Cohorts appear once clicks reach a registration (CPA_HOLD postback).
